messages.Content:
You are an adventurer in a small fantasy world. Each turn you are told
your situation and the actions available to you. Think briefly in free text about
the arithmetic of your options, then call exactly one action tool. Every action
spends days of your life, which you cannot get back. Spend them only where the
payoff is worth it.

Day 0. You have 50 days of life remaining and 0 krones. Your attack power is max(1, floor(krones/10)), currently 1.

A posted foe has 100 HP and deals 8 damage each round to your 50 HP. The tales speak of a 10-attack budget; your power comes from the krones you hold, which are never spent. Combat pays 120 krones on a win and 0 on a loss, and costs 2 days.

The quest board:
- q-1-0-0 [open] High Spine packet (delivery, 2 days, 60 krones): A sealed courier packet. 2 days on the road, 60 krones if it arrives.
- q-1-0-1 [open] Stonesong Unbinding (arcane, 3 days, 150 krones): A ritual of 3 nodes, each keyed to a different resonance (fire, water, earth) -- every resonance appears exactly once, but which node holds which is hidden. Disrupt the nodes in order. Each spell costs 2 mana; a wrong spell backlashes for 2 more. Scrying a node costs 1 mana and reveals its resonance. You start with 8 mana. Succeed and you are paid 150 krones; run dry and the ritual collapses, paying nothing. Either way it costs 3 days.
- q-1-0-2 [open] High-spine raiders (battle, 2 days, 120 krones): A foe (100 HP) holds the road. Each round it deals 8 damage to your 50 HP. Tales speak of a 10-attack budget. Your attack power is max(1, floor(krones/10)). Winning pays 120 krones; losing pays nothing.
- q-1-0-3 [open] Lantern-row dispatch (delivery, 3 days, 70 krones): A sealed courier packet. 3 days on the road, 70 krones if it arrives.
- q-1-0-4 [open] High-spine raiders (battle, 2 days, 120 krones): A foe (100 HP) holds the road. Each round it deals 8 damage to your 50 HP. Tales speak of a 10-attack budget. Your attack power is max(1, floor(krones/10)). Winning pays 120 krones; losing pays nothing.

No job is in your hands. Accept a quest, or spend a day to refresh the board.


Legal actions:
- accept_quest: Accept one open quest from the board. Costs no days; completing it later spends its listed days. You may hold only one quest at a time.
- refresh_board: Discard the remaining open jobs and draw a fresh board of 5 quests (at most 2 battles). Costs 1 day.
